entities.name: Q83HJ1 Glutamate-tRNA ligase
observations: Exact 480-residue sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q83HJ1 from Tropheryma whipplei strain TW08/27.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent glutamate activation to Glu-AMP followed by transfer of glutamate to tRNA(Glu).
Annotated process: glutamyl-tRNA aminoacylation (GO:0006424); annotated localization: cytosol (GO:0005829).
GO molecular-function annotations include glutamate-tRNA ligase activity, ATP binding, tRNA binding, and zinc ion binding.
